name: Mirror Room
hook: One mirror. Tap it and it breaks. Keep tapping.

name: Living Heart
hook: A heart that beats on your screen. Block an artery and try to save it.

name: Skin Check
hook: Scan your face in 10 seconds and see what your skin actually needs.

name: Fire vs Water
hook: Pick fire or water, summon a swarm that follows you, and sink the other team's ship.

name: Roadster Thruster Yard
hook: Drive the Tesla Roadster with SpaceX thrusters: loop the ramp, jump the Semi, and race friends in your own paint.

name: Roadster Transformer
hook: The Tesla Roadster folds into a robot. Walk, run, fly on palm and boot jets, then fold back into the car mid-run.

name: Dino Wait
hook: Chrome's dino game in colour, right above the Claude Code prompt while Claude works.
